today_summary: GCM26 marked $4,151.80 (+$62.0, +1.52%) on the 2026-08-05 chain — today's 06:50 scrape had not landed at analysis time, so this reads the prior session's book. Call volume exploded to 13,734 against 2,472 puts (5.6:1) and total call OI added 6,903 contracts in a single session to 185,946, driving P/C OI to a cycle-low 0.33. ATM IV 21.36% puts the 1σ daily move at $55.86 (1.35%). Net GEX within ±$200 of spot is −60.6 — dealers are short gamma right where price is trading, even though the broader ±20% book reads +79.1.
five_day_thesis: The five-day story is a violent repricing of the upside tail, not a directional trend: spot is up only $80.9 (+1.99%) from $4,070.90 on 07-27, but ATM IV has expanded 5.67pp from 15.69% to 21.36% and max pain has drifted $1,700 higher, from $4,800 to $6,500, where it has now pinned for four consecutive sessions. The call wall migrated from $5,370 to $8,000 (+$2,630) and that strike alone now carries 27,748 contracts — call OI across the chain grew 32.7% (140,152 → 185,946) while put OI shrank 13.8% (70,993 → 61,218). Simultaneously the put wall slid $500 lower, $4,000 → $3,500, so the downside floor was not defended, it was abandoned; hedges were sold, not rolled. GEX flipped negative on 08-04 (−10.65) and snapped back to +79.11 on 08-05, a 90-point swing in one session that marks how thin the local dealer book has become. The structural read: this is lottery-ticket call accumulation far above spot, which lifts max pain and IV without building any near-term magnet — the $6,500 max pain at +56.6% above spot is a statistical artifact of deep-OTM open interest, not a tradeable target.

prediction: Bias bullish above $4,100 while the $4,500 call wall (9,880 contracts) caps the move. Path of least resistance is a grind toward the $4,350 positive-gamma shelf (net GEX +18.2) and then the wall itself; the gamma flip at $4,750 means dealer hedging stays destabilizing until price clears it, so expect the advance to be choppy rather than trending. Below $4,070 the short-gamma pocket reopens and the $4,000 put concentration (2,943 OI, net GEX −33.6) becomes the target — that level invalidates the long thesis.
